simple.meaning: שְׁמָמָה (shᵉmâmâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “devastation ; figuratively, astonishment.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 58 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Joshua, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 23:29. The surrounding contexts include land, mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמָמָה (H8077) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁמָמָה (shᵉmâmâh) / H8077 is traced through Exodus 23:29, Leviticus 26:33, Joshua 8:28, Isaiah 1:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.
